title: Stub GET /Items/{itemId}/ThemeMedia is not on any differential request, and echoes a malformed id as OwnerId
notes: internal/api/items.go themeMedia sets OwnerId from CompactID(r.PathValue("itemId")) with no validation, and test/differential/requests.yaml has no ThemeMedia request. Calling the handler directly with no path value (an empty id) makes the checker report `$.ThemeSongsResult field OwnerId: "" is not a uuid`. The same route with a malformed id such as /Items/abc/ThemeMedia gives OwnerId "abc", which  Closed at the pivot: Both auditors: tied to Jellyfin's API, its apps, jellyfin-web or its captures, which go at the cutover (D-107, mandate rule 3).
